story.vex: One relay, one feed, one antenna. One well-placed hit ends it all. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: every single point of failure is identified before Vex could find it first. Astro: "One failure should never mean total loss. Not anymore."

=================
Read relay-architecture.txt: four components. Classify each as single-point-of-failure or already-redundant.

files.C:\\Citadel\\relay-architecture.txt:
RELAY SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
----------------------------
component-relay          one relay unit, no backup — if it fails, contact is lost
component-power-feed     one power source, no backup — if it cuts out, everything stops
component-antenna        one antenna, no backup — if damaged, no signal at all
component-cooling        two cooling units running together, load-balanced

steps.title: Read the architecture note
steps.body: Rivet: "Read every component before flagging any." `type relay-architecture.txt`.

steps.title: Find every single point of failure
steps.body: Rivet: "No backup, one failure ends it — that's a single point of failure. Already load-balanced — that's redundant." Classify all four components.
